messages:
Anya: Hey! New hire Anya here. Received the Logitech BRIO from the shipment but the image looks really washed out and skin tones are kind of green. Tested in Zoom and QuickTime. Any quick fixes?
it-sam: welcome Anya :wave: can you confirm OS and whether you're plugged into the dock or direct to laptop? also, do you see the camera listed as "Logitech BRIO" or "USB Video Device"?
Anya: macOS Sonoma 14.2.2, plugged into the WD19 dock (USB-C). It shows up as "Logitech Brio" in System Settings -> Video. Zoom has a low-contrast preview too.
Jordan: quick checks: 1) try direct to laptop (bypass dock) to rule out USB negotiation. 2) check camera app settings: Logitech G HUB (if installed) or Zoom color controls. 3) try forcing UVC controls via ffmpeg/OBS to see raw stream.
it-sam: to test raw feed (mac) run: `ffmpeg -f avfoundation -list_devices true -i ""` then `ffmpeg -f avfoundation -framerate 30 -pixel_format uyvy422 -i "0" -t 5 dump.mp4` and inspect. on Windows use `v4l2-ctl`/Device Manager.
Anya: plugged direct to laptop USB-C, still greenish. I don't have Logitech G HUB installed.
it-bot: created ticket INC-5702 for Anya (priority: medium) 1https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-5702
Jordan: firmware/drivers are a common culprit. We push Logitech firmware via Jamf/Intune for company devices; if you're personal, G HUB can update firmware. Also check that automatic white balance (AWB) is enabled in the camera controls; if AWB/auto exposure is struggling under our fluorescent lights it can tint.
it-sam: can you upload a short 10s sample (QuickTime recording or dump.mp4) to the ticket? also include a photo of your desk lighting if possible.
Anya: uploaded quicktime clip and photo to INC-5702. Desk is under two ceiling LEDs, no colored lights.
Jordan: thanks. I looked at the clip 1 the UVC metadata shows pixel format being used as YUY2 and auto-white balance is toggling frequently. Two workarounds: 1) use Logitech Camera Settings / G HUB to set white balance to manual (6500K) and lock exposure. 2) if you prefer, we can push a driver/firmware update from our MDM.
it-sam: Ops: can we schedule a Jamf remote session? We should also add a short KB to new-hire docs explaining BRIO common fixes. @Ops any deployment notes?
Ops: scheduled Jamf remote in 20m. For company devices we prefer firmware push + G HUB uninstall (G HUB can be flaky). We'll apply vendor firmware v1.17.3 and then lock via configuration profile.
Anya: remote session worked, firmware updated and white balance set to 6500K manually. Colors look normal now, zoom preview fixed. Huge thanks! :tada:
it-sam: awesome. closing INC-5702 and adding KB entry: "Logitech BRIO washed/green image: test direct USB, update firmware, set AWB manual 6500K, lock exposure, avoid G HUB if on company image."
Jordan: adding short note to new-hire checklist: if webcam issues, try direct connect + firmware before RMA.
Anya: appreciate the help 1 excited to be here :heart:
